stop_rule: Preserve failed/partial/unrun cells. Stop remaining cells on integrity, replay, unknown usage or accounting failure; no replacement runs.
grading_rule: Only after all searches end; grade each frozen valid submission once, never feed official scores back to search.
missing_cells: Remain in the nine-cell denominator; no retries or seed substitution.
